qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Industrial plant maintenance, modifications, and engineering services for process industries (chemicals, pharma, energy). Despite sticky on-site plant presence, maintenance services are subject to periodic competitive re-tendering by industrial clients. Operating EBITA margins of 3-5% and multi-year ROIC history below the 12% threshold reflect absence of a structural moat.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype 'None' & Proof of Moat, REJECT). German industrial maintenance provider operating on thin 3-5% EBITA margins with multi-year historical returns on capital below the 12% hurdle. Contracts face ongoing competitive re-bidding from industrial service peers.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year EBITA margins have ranged from 2.4% (2022) to 5.1% (2024). 5-year median ROIC sits well below the 12% hurdle (ROCE was 3.2% in 2022 and only briefly touched 12.1% in 2023 following restructuring and tax asset recognitions). Lacks structural pricing power or an insurmountable competitive barrier.
